claims.text: Abridge announced on October 8th, 2026 an enterprise-wide agreement with University of Texas REAL Health AI.
claims.quote: SAN FRANCISCO, California — October 8, 2026 — Abridge today announced an enterprise-wide agreement with University of Texas REAL Health AI to expand access to Abridge’s clinician intelligence platform across the UT System.
claims.scope_note: Vendor press release datelined October 8th, 2026. The announcement comes from Abridge.
claims.verification: Corrected after validator REVISE round 1, awaiting charged follow-up review.

claims.text: Abridge says the agreement provides a systemwide framework through which UT health institutions can access Abridge while preserving local decision-making.
claims.quote: The agreement provides a systemwide framework through which UT health institutions can access Abridge while preserving local decision-making
claims.scope_note: Access framework as described by the vendor. No deployment dates are stated.

claims.text: Texas Senate Bill 1188 lets a practitioner use artificial intelligence for diagnostic purposes under conditions that include reviewing all records created with artificial intelligence consistent with Texas Medical Board standards.
claims.quote: the practitioner reviews all records created with   artificial intelligence in a manner that is consistent with medical   records standards developed by the Texas Medical Board.
claims.scope_note: Enrolled text of S.B. 1188, 89th Legislature. Section 183.005(a) states three conditions together and subsection (b) separately requires disclosure to patients. The review condition sits in a provision about diagnostic purposes.
claims.verification: Corrected after validator REVISE round 1, awaiting charged follow-up review.
